info.title: 2M ml-api (internal)
info.summary: Internal ML service: intent classification, FAQ chat with RAG, and delivery ETA.
info.description: v0.2 for WP-02, approved by AE, FS and DS on 2026-11-26. Only the Node API calls this service; browsers and apps must never reach it and never hold the LLM key. Every /v1 request carries the `X-Internal-Key` header. JSON fields are snake_case. Every successful /v1 response carries `model_version`. Errors use the same envelope as the Node API: `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details?" } }`. FastAPI's default 422 validation body must be remapped to this envelope with code `VALIDATION_ERROR` and status 400. Requests must not contain customer PII (names, phone numbers, addresses, other customers' order codes); Node masks the text before calling. Follows decisions D1 (FAQ chatbot + RAG), D2 (intent classifier as the main model, ETA regression from DS) and D4 (FAISS cpu, embedding behind a provider interface), locked on 2026-11-24 in PROJECT_PLAN.md section 5.

get.description: No key required so the hosting platform can probe it. Exposes no data beyond versions and up/down flags. `status` is `ok` while the intent model is loaded, even if the LLM is down, because chat can still answer with the extractive fallback. Before the intent model ships (WP-13) the skeleton answers `ok` with `model_version: "none"` and `llm: "down"` so the hosting platform can probe it.

post.summary: Answer a customer question from the 2M knowledge base
post.description: Retrieves passages from `services/ml-api/knowledge/` and answers from those passages only. The user message is treated as data, never as instructions. When the LLM is unavailable, times out or is over budget, the service answers with an extractive fallback and sets `fallback_used: true` instead of failing, so `AI_UNAVAILABLE`, `AI_TIMEOUT` and `AI_BUDGET_EXCEEDED` are returned only when no fallback answer can be produced. Node keeps the daily per-user budget; this service enforces its own monthly cap.

example.answer: Ongkir dihitung dari jarak rute dan berat pesanan. Totalnya tampil di halaman checkout sebelum kamu membayar.

post.summary: Predict total delivery time for an order
post.description: Predicts the minutes from the moment a courier claims the order (ACCEPTED to PICKING) until DELIVERED, matching the DS label `target_eta_menit`. Call it once the order has a courier; time before the claim (payment, branch acceptance, waiting in the job pool) is not part of the prediction. The model is trained on simulated orders (`sumber_data = SINTETIS_SIMULASI`, see data-science/data_dictionary.md), so treat it as an estimate for display, not a promise. No branch or order identifier is sent; the model treats the branch as an unseen category.

InternalKey.name: X-Internal-Key
InternalKey.description: Shared secret between Node and ml-api. Stored only in server environment variables.

ModelVersion.description: Version of the model artifact that produced the response, e.g. `intent-2026.11.0`.

Intent.description: Intent classes from WP-11. Adding, removing or renaming a class is a contract change.

llm.description: `down` when the LLM provider is unreachable, out of budget or the circuit breaker is open.

text.description: One customer message, already masked by Node. Longer text returns 413 `AI_INPUT_TOO_LONG`.

alternatives.description: Next-best intents, highest confidence first, excluding `intent`. At most 2 items.

message.description: The customer's question, already masked by Node. Longer text returns 413 `AI_INPUT_TOO_LONG`.

history.description: Earlier turns of the same thread, oldest first. Node sends at most the last 6 turns.

branch_id.description: Branch the customer shops from, used to pick branch-specific knowledge (hours, area). No user identifiers are sent.

ChatUsage.description: Copied by Node into `llm_usage`. When the answer comes from the extractive fallback without an LLM call, `model` is `extractive` and both token counts are 0.

model.description: LLM model name as reported by the provider, or `extractive`.

prompt_version.description: Version of the prompt template, e.g. `faq-v1`.

latency_ms.description: Wall time inside ml-api for this request.

cached.description: True when the answer came from the response cache.

answer.description: Answer in Bahasa Indonesia, plain text.

sources.description: Passages the answer is based on. Empty when the question is out of scope (`di_luar_konteks`) and the answer is a refusal.

fallback_used.description: True when the answer came from the extractive fallback instead of the LLM.

distance_km.description: One-way route distance from branch to address (`orders.route_distance_km`; DS column `jarak_rute_km`).

weight_kg.description: Total order weight (DS column `berat_total_kg`). Null when unknown; ml-api imputes the training median and sets the `berat_estimasi` flag internally.

item_count.description: Number of order lines, not units (DS column `jumlah_item`).

hour.description: Time of day the courier claimed the order, as decimal hours in Asia/Jakarta time (17.5 = 17:30; DS column `jam`).

dow.description: Day of week the courier claimed the order, Asia/Jakarta time; 0 = Monday, 6 = Sunday (DS column `hari_minggu`).

motor_cluster.description: Claiming courier's motor cluster (`couriers.motor_cluster`; DS column `klaster_motor`). Null or omitted only if the cluster is unknown; the model then treats it as an unseen category.

eta_minutes.description: Predicted minutes from courier claim to DELIVERED, rounded up.

eta_range_minutes.description: Rough display range `[low, high]`: the prediction minus and plus the frozen-test RMSE, low rounded down and never below 1, high rounded up. Not a calibrated prediction interval.

weight_imputed.description: True when `weight_kg` was null and the training median was used (DS `berat_estimasi = 1`).

message.description: Developer-facing English text. Frontends map `code` to Bahasa Indonesia and never show this message.

details.description: Optional structured detail, e.g. failing field names for VALIDATION_ERROR.

BudgetExceeded.description: Monthly LLM budget used up and no fallback answer was possible (`AI_BUDGET_EXCEEDED`)

Unavailable.description: Model not loaded, or LLM down with no fallback answer (`AI_UNAVAILABLE`)

Timeout.description: LLM call exceeded the time limit and no fallback answer was possible (`AI_TIMEOUT`)
